economy.summary: Her campaign says she has fought for state budgets every year that cut the cost of living and invest in public health infrastructure, family support, and workforce development, and says all jobs should pay enough that people can afford living expenses, noting Pennsylvania's minimum wage is the lowest in its region.
economy.short: Says she fought for budgets cutting cost of living; backs higher wages.

taxes.summary: Says state funding cuts to public schools force local school boards to raise property taxes to avoid cutting services, and that she has ensured schools received an increase in state funding every year she has been in office.
taxes.short: Says increased state school funding prevents local property tax increases.

abortion.summary: Her campaign says she fights to make sure that choice is not restricted by harmful laws, and supports policies addressing maternal mortality along with universal pre-K and paid family leave.
abortion.short: Says she fights laws restricting choice; backs maternal health policies.

education.summary: Says she has ensured public schools received increased state funding each year in office, sponsored a bill that passed the House unanimously providing tuition waivers for children raised by non-parent relatives, and advocates for state-funded, free, inclusive early childhood education.
education.short: Supports increased public school funding and state-funded early childhood education.

healthcare.summary: Passed legislation signed into law in 2024 regulating pharmacy benefit managers, which her campaign says will help lower prescription costs; opposes Medicaid cuts affecting Pennsylvania residents and supports long-term care services allowing disabled people and seniors to stay in their homes.
healthcare.short: Passed pharmacy benefit manager law; opposes Medicaid cuts; backs home care.

energy.summary: Supports holding oil and gas companies accountable for treatment of workers and environmental violations, raises concerns about data center impacts on communities, and advocates for infrastructure investments in water and stormwater management.
energy.short: Supports oil and gas accountability; concerned about data center impacts.

guns.summary: Supports what her campaign calls commonsense legislation including comprehensive background checks, extreme risk protection orders, firearm safety training, and safe storage laws.
guns.short: Supports background checks, risk protection orders, safe storage laws.

taxes.summary: His campaign supports transparent budgeting, reducing wasteful spending, and lower taxes, saying tax dollars should be used efficiently for communities.
taxes.short: Supports transparent budgeting, reduced wasteful spending, lower taxes.

abortion.summary: His campaign says every life has value and supports policies protecting life while strengthening support systems for mothers, families, and children.
abortion.short: Supports policies protecting life and support systems for families.

education.summary: Supports both strong public schools and family choice options including charter schools and career training programs, and advocates for transparency in schools and parental involvement in decisions affecting children.
education.short: Supports public schools, charter and career options, parental involvement.

guns.summary: Supports protecting the Second Amendment while ensuring laws focus on criminals rather than responsible gun owners, and backs law enforcement working to keep neighborhoods safe while maintaining accountability and community trust.
guns.short: Supports Second Amendment protections; backs law enforcement and accountability.
